title: Will the Kawhi Trade Go Through? Plus, Donovan Mitchell Extends, and Summer League Debuts
description:
Zach is joined by Howard Beck to discuss the Kawhi Leonard trade possibly not going through due to the NBA's ongoing investigation. Next, they discuss Donovan Mitchell's contract extension, where LeBron could end up, and the Summer League debuts of AJ Dybantsa and Darryn Peterson.



(0:00) Welcome to The Zach Lowe Show!

(03:12) Will the Kawhi trade go through?

(21:58) Donovan Mitchell's contract extension

(44:41) LeBron's next team

(53:16) Summer League debuts
